problem: Two cats share one sunny windowsill. Mochi jumps up at a random time between 1:00 and 2:00 and naps for 10 minutes. Tofu jumps up at a random time in the same hour and naps for 20 minutes. What is the probability that both cats are on the sill at the same time?
rule: Make every outcome a point. Chance = good area ÷ total area.

problem: Cars A, B, C, D and E sit in that order on a round Ferris wheel. From car C, cars A and B look 30° apart. From D, B and C look 25° apart. From E, C and D look 35° apart. From A, D and E look 40° apart. From car B, how many degrees apart do A and E look?
rule: An angle on the circle is half the arc it sees. Double to get arcs, fill to 360°, halve back.

problem: When P(x) is divided by x − 2, the remainder is 7. When P(x) is divided by x + 3, the remainder is −8. What is the remainder when P(x) is divided by x² + x − 6?
rule: At a root of the divisor, only the remainder is left. Plug in the roots and solve.

problem: A delivery drone flies 7 km due east. Then it turns 60° to the left and flies 8 km. How far is it now from where it started?
rule: c² = a² + b² − 2ab·cos C. C is the angle BETWEEN the two sides.
move: Turn the 60° turn into the 120° inside angle, then use c² = a² + b² − 2ab·cos C
trap: Using the 60° turn as the angle: √57
